project_type: Python FastAPI EDMS with Jinja2 HTML templates, htmx, and Tailwind CSS
test_framework: pytest-asyncio with SQLite in-memory fixtures. conftest.py provides db_session and client fixtures. Tests use httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport.
build_command: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
verification_instructions: 1. Run uv run ruff check app/ tests/ for linting. 2. Run uv run pytest tests/ -q --tb=short to confirm all tests pass (baseline: 697 passing).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - can install packages via uv add. Python 3.11.14 available. No Docker daemon needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: models in app/models/, API routes in app/api/, schemas in app/schemas/, services in app/services/, templates in app/templates/. Register routers in app/api/router.py. Use SQLAlchemy async with mapped_column pattern. Tests go in tests/test_<feature>.py using conftest fixtures.
key_patterns: Models inherit from Base (app/models/group.py). IDs are either int (autoincrement) or String(36) UUID. User IDs are String(36). ForeignKeys use ondelete CASCADE. API routers use tags=[]. Auth via get_current_user dependency. Notifications via get_notification_manager().create_notification(). Schemas use Pydantic BaseModel with model_config from_attributes. Templates extend base.html, use Tailwind + htmx. Pages served from app/api/pages.py.
directory_structure: app/ - main application (api/, core/, models/, schemas/, services/, templates/, middleware/). tests/ - pytest test files. storage/ - file storage. wiki/ - LLM wiki output.
